proto-gen.template: Run `buf generate` from the project root to regenerate all Go, TypeScript, and C# code from proto definitions. Then verify there are no lint errors with `buf lint`.
proto-gen.description: Generate code from proto definitions using Buf

proto-lint.template: Run `buf lint` on the proto directory and report any issues. For each issue, explain what the lint rule means and how to fix it.

proto-breaking.template: Run `buf breaking --against .git#branch=main` to check for breaking changes in proto definitions. Report all breaking changes and suggest backward-compatible alternatives.

test.template: Run the Go test suite with `go test ./...` from the project root. Report failures and suggest fixes.

docker-up.template: Start all services using `docker-compose up -d` and verify they are healthy. Report any container failures.

analyze-upgrade.template: Read the upgrade.md file and the .resources/ directory. Analyze what features from the reference projects could be implemented next. Focus on proto-first integration patterns that fit the existing architecture.
